pages.title: Blaze Burner and Heat
pages.text:
Some recipes need **heat**. Create gets it from the **Blaze Burner**, which also boosts basin recipes and powers steam engine boilers.

The burner is not crafted whole: you capture a living blaze in an **Empty Blaze Burner**.

pages.title: Empty Blaze Burner
pages.text: Right-click a blaze with it to capture the blaze. Blazes can also be collected from their spawners. Then put the burner under a basin or boiler.

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Feed it flammable items by hand, or let a deployer or mechanical arm do it. It cools down when its fuel runs out.
**Two levels**: fed with fuel it is **heated**. Fed a **Blaze Cake** it becomes **superheated**, the stronger tier some recipes need. A superheated burner also counts as heated.

pages.title: Blaze Cake
pages.text: Takes a burner to the stronger tier. Check JEI (R, U) for its recipe and the recipes that need superheating.

**What uses heat**:

- Mixer and press recipes marked heated or superheated

- Steam engine boilers: fluid tanks sitting on a burner heat water to steam

- Fans: see [#](2E5AAC)[Encased Fans](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() for what counts as a fan catalyst.

**Other mods**: the tag Create reads for boiler heat also includes Farmer's Delight's **Stove**, Twilight Forest's fiery storage blocks, and lava, magma blocks, campfires and fire. These work as passive boiler heaters, weaker than a burner.
Burners can also burn liquid fuel from pipes: see [#](2E5AAC)[Burning Liquid Fuel](entry://industry/liquid_fuel)[#]().
